idea-plugin.name: Inline Reading Mode
idea-plugin.description: Read code without jumping between files: put the caret on a method call and press Ctrl+Alt+Shift+= to show the callee's body inline below the call — read-only, syntax-highlighted, recursive (expand calls inside the expanded body too). Press the shortcut again, Esc, or click the header to collapse.

action.description: Show the called method's body inline below the call, read-only
